This is a remote position.

Join ProudVoices – Help Shape the Future of Immersive Queer TechPosition:ProudVoices Council Member (Volunteer Role) Location:Remote / Global Commitment:~2–4 hours per month Term:6 months

What Is ProudVoices?

ProudVoices is a global volunteer council of 2SLGBTQ+ community members who bring their lived experiences, critical perspectives, and bold ideas to the heart of ProudZone. You’ll help us ensure that what we build reflects the full spectrum of queer lives, not just a privileged few.

We’re not looking for “perfect resumes”. We want people who are passionate about justice, visibility, and making tech a safer, more inclusive space. If you’ve ever felt erased or underserved by a product, or queer space, this is your opportunity to help change that.

What You'll Do

  • Attend at least one virtual council meeting per month (sometimes two, if urgent topics arise)

  • Provide feedback on product inclusivity, accessibility, and community engagement strategies

  • Share your insights on how tech can better serveyourcommunity

  • Help steer an emerging queer tech environment to be safer, more representative, and globally conscious


Requirements

Who We’re Looking For

The LGBTQ+ community is beautifully vast across gender identities, races, cultures, abilities, income levels, and lived experiences. Unfortunately, many of these voices are often excluded from decision-making spaces, even within our own communities.

ProudVoices aims to center those who’ve been sidelined, especially individuals living in geographies where being LGBTQ+ remains dangerous, criminalized, or heavily policed. Your perspective helps us better understand how to build safe, global-first, and trauma-aware experiences.

No tech experience required! Just real talk, clear values, and a willingness to collaborate.

How to Apply & What to Expect

To apply, fill out a short questionnaire (no CV required). We just want to know who you are and what your story is!

If selected, you’ll be invited to a brief video call with our Chief HR & Community Officer (CHRCO). If chosen to join the council, you’ll be welcomed on an intro call with our CEO and guided through a short volunteer onboarding process.

Please Note

  • This is an unpaid, volunteer advisory role and there areno labor obligations

  • We arenot collecting resumes

  • This is a global opportunity open to 2SLGBTQ+ folks everywhere
